derivation: Simple Enchanting sells nothing: the enchanters are made in the world from an enchanting table with a hammer and eight nuggets (until 03.11. SimpleBuilding's Astral Enchanting Table, which had no price either); its building-block twins only exist without SimpleBuilding, whose blocks they are.

excluded.simpleenchanting:dark_enchanter: Made in the world from an Enchanting Table, a Netherite hammer and 8 Netherite Nuggets; a trade would skip the upgrade.
excluded.simpleenchanting:astral_enchanter: Made in the world from a Dark Enchanter, an Enderite hammer and 8 Enderite Nuggets; a trade would skip the End stage.
excluded.simpleenchanting:blazing_obsidian: Twin of SimpleBuilding's block (only without it); crafted from Vanilla materials.
